newsitem.title: RUSSIA: At least one person dies in Russian fire.
newsitem.headline: At least one person dies in Russian fire.

text.p: At least one person died and another three were injured when a powerful explosion damaged an apartment block in northwestern Russia on Friday, Interfax news agency said.
It quoted the Emergencies Ministry as saying the blast, soon after midnight in the town of Priozersk 120 km (80 miles) north of St Petersburg, was probably caused by a leak in a gas stove.
Rescue work was still under way in the apartment block, half of which had been badly damaged.
Russian fire fighters complain that the number of fires in apartment blocks grows every winter as people try to get extra heat using makeshift electric devices or gas stoves.
